description: A tempest mage born of Shelldrift's eternal storms, who calls down lightning from the grey coastal skies. Thunder follows where they point.
icon_hint: crackling electric blue storm cloud with lightning bolts arcing downward
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy stormcaller lightning mage class on a misty coast. Weathered driftwood border crackling with blue-white lightning at corners. Dark storm-cloud grey center with electric blue lightning veins branching across. Small crackling storm cloud at bottom. Color palette: dark storm grey, electric blue, white lightning. No characters, no text.
